source.rule: A BSID variant statically inherits the base system's item structure and may add an item. Separately deployed base and variant are distinct physical systems; their mission and failure identifiers must be traced separately. This is not a CBSID runtime reconfiguration.

configuration.missions_per_unit: schedule at h8, h20 and h32; duration two hours

exact_delta: Starting from the accepted add-extra parent, append one base Unit, one base SystemDeployment row, and one Operations row binding that unit to the existing schedule; change ProblemDescription. All System, Item, ItemStructure, repair, stock, mission, seed, and report-control rows remain byte-identical in the parsed model.
pre_run_hypothesis: Both physical systems should receive their own three scheduled missions. The zero-rate base should have no item failure, while the variant may fail through TEACH-LRU-ADD under the inherited/additive composition. The parent variant-only seed-1 run failed at h9.8829, but a second unit may alter random draw order; no exact child time is prespecified.

The event log should identify both system and unit instances for mission assignment and should identify any failure path and stock demand/repair target. The aggregate report must reconcile with those events and show two terminal ready systems.
native_acceptance: Guarded session-0 SSH import/export, calculation, report export, exact authored-table roundtrip, and GUI PID13340/host mutex/registry/source continuity.
Zero converter errors/notes, individually classified warnings, valid SXO/event log/report and 72 aligned half-hour System and Stock bins.

Separate base and variant mission identities, base zero-failure exposure, at least one added-LRU variant failure and associated local demand/repair, all six mission outcomes, and terminal two-system readiness reconciled to report.
Separate read-only reviewer replays source delta, raw seals, event chronology, ledgers and terminal state without importing author validation.
diagnostic_gate: If the native run rejects the input or lacks separate base/variant mission identity or added-LRU failure and repair, retain it as diagnostic; revise candidate/version and run ID before another native attempt, without widening positive claims.
limits: One BSID add variant, one separately deployed base, one station, one seed and one replication; no rate or population inference.
The report is aggregate; per-system assignment and failure attribution require the event log. No CBSID conversion, simultaneous add/exclude, GUI visual or cross-engine claim.
